description:
**Are you an HR professional who wants to do more than paperwork? Ready to build a culture, not just manage one?**

At **Sheows**, we believe a company is only as strong as its people. We are looking for a sharp, driven and people-first **HR Lead** to own our HR function and play a key role in our next phase of growth.

Job Snapshot

**Location:** Gurgaon

**Experience:** 4 to 7 years in HR

**Salary:** ₹60,000 – ₹70,000 per month

**Job Type:** Full-time, Work from Office

**Reports To:** CEO

**Joining:** Immediate

About the Role

This is a leadership position, not a support role. As HR Lead, you will be the face of HR at Sheows, working directly with the leadership team to attract the right talent, keep them engaged and build systems that scale with the business.

Key Responsibilities

**Talent Acquisition**

* Own the complete hiring cycle: manpower planning, JD creation, sourcing, screening, interviews, offer negotiation and closure
* Build a strong talent pipeline through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals and campus channels
* Reduce time-to-hire while maintaining quality of hire

**Onboarding & Induction**

* Run a smooth onboarding process, from documentation to day-one experience
* Conduct induction programs so new joiners settle in faster

**Employee Engagement & Culture**

* Plan engagement activities, recognition programs and team-building initiatives
* Collect regular feedback and act on it to improve retention

**Performance Management**

* Design and run KRA/KPI-based performance review cycles
* Support managers with appraisals, feedback and development plans

**HR Operations**

* Manage attendance, leave, payroll inputs and employee records
* Maintain HR MIS, dashboards and monthly reports

**Statutory Compliance & Legal**

* Ensure timely registration, filing and compliance under:
* **EPF** (Employees’ Provident Fund): monthly ECR filing and contributions
* **ESIC** (Employees’ State Insurance): registration, contributions and returns
* **Payment of Gratuity Act**
* **Minimum Wages Act** and applicable state wage regulations
* **Shops & Establishment Act** (registration, renewals, leave and working-hours norms)
* **Professional Tax** and **TDS on salary** (coordinating with the finance/accounts team)
* **Maternity Benefit Act** and other applicable labour laws
* **POSH Act**: constitution and functioning of the Internal Committee (IC), annual reports and awareness sessions
* Maintain statutory registers, records and documentation, and stay audit-ready at all times
* Coordinate with consultants, auditors and government authorities during inspections and audits
* Keep track of changes in labour codes and update company policies accordingly

**Policy & Employee Relations**

* Create, update and implement HR policies, SOPs, appointment letters and employee handbook
* Handle grievances and disciplinary matters fairly and confidentially
* Manage exit formalities, including exit interviews, notice period, and full & final settlement

**Strategic Partnership**

* Advise leadership on organization structure, compensation and workforce planning
* Strengthen Sheows’ employer brand on LinkedIn and other platforms

What We’re Looking For

**Must have**

* Bachelor’s degree in any stream; MBA / PGDM in HR preferred
* 4 to 7 years of hands-on HR experience, with at least 1 to 2 years in a lead role
* Strong command over end-to-end recruitment and HR operations
* **Solid working knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance (EPF, ESIC, Gratuity, Bonus, PT, POSH, Shops & Establishment Act)**
* **Hands-on experience in compliance filings, audits and handling inspections**
* Excellent communication, negotiation and people-management skills
* Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS tools and LinkedIn Recruiter
* Comfortable working from the office on a full-time basis

**Good to have**

* Experience in a startup or fast-growing company
* Exposure to payroll processing and HR analytics
* Knowledge of the new Labour Codes
* Experience in employer branding initiatives

You’ll Thrive Here If You

* Take ownership and don’t wait to be told what to do
* Are equally comfortable with people and data
* Are detail-oriented and never miss a compliance deadline
* Stay calm under pressure and handle sensitive situations with maturity
* Think like a business partner, not just an HR executive

Why Join Sheows?

**Leadership role** with real ownership and direct access to decision-makers

**Growth-oriented environment** where you shape the HR function

**Competitive salary** of ₹60,000 – ₹70,000 per month

**People-first culture** that values respect, learning and accountability

**Collaborative office environment** where you work closely with the team and leadership

**Exposure** to every part of the business

How to Apply

Apply directly through this post or send your updated CV to hrgurgaon@sheows.org with the subject line **“HR Lead ”**.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Benefits:

title: Global L&D Innovation Director
description:
**Locations**: London | Lisbon | Gurgaon

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As the Global L&D Innovation Director, you will lead the innovation engine within BCG's Global Learning & Development Strategy & Transformation Office. Reporting to the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Senior Director, you will run a ringfenced innovation team focused on identifying, prototyping, and PoC testing the next generation of online learning experiences for BCG.

BCG's L&D model is evolving to deliver faster, more personalized, data-informed, and AI-enabled upskilling in support of BCG's 2030 strategy. You will be a critical leader in making that roadmap real, helping stand up the innovation team and tech squad, pilot adaptive learning, develop agentic learning prototypes to scale new products and experiences over time.

You will lead work across three connected domains:

* Innovation portfolio management - shaping the intake, prioritization, sequencing, governance, and delivery discipline for a portfolio of high-priority L&D innovation initiatives
* Experimentation and product development - leading the development and validation of new audience-facing learning experiences, products, formats, and AI-enabled solutions
* Implementation and scaling - partnering across L&D, Talent, IT/Product, and business stakeholders to move successful pilots into durable products, programs, platforms, or operating routines

The work will include experimentation with AI tools, AI workflows and automation for L&D internal transformation, and prototyping and piloting of agentic and adaptive learning experiences aligned to the 2030 L&D strategy. You will help BCG shift from slower, programmatic learning cycles toward rapid upskilling in short cycles - weeks, not years - particularly for emerging business needs and technical skills.

What You'll Bring

* 10+ years of experience in innovation, product management, digital transformation, learning transformation, talent/capability building, strategy execution, or enterprise program leadership
* Experience leading teams in complex, global, matrixed environments, with a strong track record of coaching, developing, and mobilizing talent
* Demonstrated ability to move work from ideation through design, build, pilot and value proof.
* Experience in designing innovation with scale in mind, anticipating the technical, integration, and operating requirements needed to move successful pilots into production and enable a smooth handover to Product and IT
* Curiosity and the desire to change the status quo.
* Strong technology literacy, including comfort working with AI-enabled tools, digital products, workflow automation, learning platforms, or data-enabled solutions
* Experience managing a portfolio of initiatives with competing priorities, limited resources, and senior stakeholder visibility
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional partners, and manage tradeoffs with sound judgment
* Experience working with agile, product-led, design-thinking, test-and-learn, or rapid prototyping approaches
* Strong problem-solving and structured thinking, with the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous or fast-changing topics
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical or conceptual ideas into clear business and learning implications
* Comfort operating at both strategic and executional levels - you can set direction and personally help get the work done
* Experience in L&D, talent, capability building, HR transformation, or professional services is preferred, but not required for candidates with strong innovation, product, or transformation experience
* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred

Who You'll Work With

You will report to the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Senior Director and lead the innovation team within the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Office.

Your direct leadership scope will include the ringfenced innovation team responsible for developing and validating new learning experiences, products, formats, AI-enabled workflows, and agentic/adaptive prototypes. This team will act as a rapid experimentation and delivery capability for the L&D organization, helping relieve pressure from teams managing structured curricula and foundational programs while responding to accelerating demand for digital and AI upskilling.

You will work closely with:

* L&D Strategy Implementation & Transformation to align innovation priorities with the broader 2030 L&D roadmap, governance, investment choices, and transformation milestones
* Rapid AI Adoption teams to connect innovation efforts with urgent business-critical skill needs, AI upskilling priorities, and emerging technical capability requirements
* L&D Business Partners to understand demand from BCG's cohorts, businesses, regions, and functions and translate that demand into prioritized innovation opportunities
* Learning Architecture and Curriculum teams to ensure successful pilots can be embedded into learning journeys and sustained beyond the innovation team
* Learning Product and Operations teams to transition proven solutions into scalable delivery models, platforms, processes, and operating routines
* IT, Product, Data, and AI teams to ensure prototypes and pilots are technically feasible, well-integrated, secure, and aligned with BCG's broader technology ecosystem
* HR, Talent, and People Strategy teams to connect learning innovation to broader skill, performance, talent, and workforce priorities
* Vendors and external partners where third-party platforms, content, tools, or technical capabilities can accelerate delivery

Together, you will help BCG build a faster, more adaptive, more technology-enabled learning ecosystem - one that strengthens our world-class apprenticeship and faculty-led learning while creating scalable, personalized, data-informed learning experiences for the future.

Additional info

**YOU'RE GOOD AT-**

* Taking ideas from concept to implementation - You can start with an ambiguous business or learning need, shape the problem, define the opportunity, mobilize the right people, test a technical solution, and evaluate what is needed to drive adoption and scale.
* Running a high-quality innovation portfolio - You bring structure to fast-moving work. You can manage intake, prioritization, resourcing, stage gates, decision rights, dependencies, risks, and handoffs without slowing the team down.
* Leading agile, multidisciplinary teams - You know how to lead teams that may include a mix of learning designers, product owners, technologists, data and analytics colleagues, AI specialists, vendors, and business SMEs. You create clarity, energy, accountability, and momentum.
* Applying technology and AI pragmatically - You are tech literate and curious. You do not need to be an engineer, but you can engage credibly with technical teams, understand what AI and digital tools can and cannot do, and translate emerging capabilities into usable learning solutions.
* Building solutions that are learner-centered and business-backed - You can connect business goals to skill needs, translate those needs into learning experiences, and keep outcomes at the center of the work.
* Collaborating across a complex ecosystem - You can operate in a global, matrixed environment and build strong partnerships with L&D Business Partners, Learning Architecture, Product and Operations, Talent, HR, IT, Product, and senior business stakeholders.
* Managing stakeholders with confidence and judgment - You know how to shape demand, negotiate tradeoffs, communicate progress, surface decisions, and keep stakeholders aligned across seniority levels and functions.
* Experimenting with discipline - You are comfortable with rapid prototyping, piloting, feedback loops, and iteration, but you also know when to stop, pivot, scale, or hand off.
* Leading people through ambiguity and change - You build trust, coach teams, manage performance, and help people do excellent work in a space where priorities, tools, and expectations are evolving quickly.
* Translating innovation into adoption - You understand that a successful prototype is only valuable if it is used. You think ahead about change management, communications, enablement, measurement, and integration into existing workflows.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

About the Business

Thermodyne Engineering Systems is an engineering and manufacturing business with annual turnover of ~₹50 crores and manufacturing facilities in Ghaziabad and Alwar. Its activities include boiler manufacturing, installation, service and AMC, exports, and trading.

The business plans to transition from a proprietorship to a private limited or limited company within one year, explore acquisitions of complementary businesses, and work towards a public issue over approximately three years.

Role Purpose

We seek a hands-on finance leader who can build reliable accounting, accurate job costing, effective financial controls, and useful management dashboards, while supporting corporate transition, acquisitions, fundraising, and expansion.

The CFO will lead the existing three-person accounts team and oversee finance across Thermodyne, associated businesses, and future corporate entities. This role requires direct involvement in execution, process building, and team development.

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounting, Reporting and Financial Visibility

Establish accurate, timely, and auditable accounting with clear reconciliation and review procedures.

Implement a disciplined monthly closing process and prepare management accounts with meaningful analysis.

Develop weekly and monthly dashboards covering cash position, profitability, order margins, receivables, inventory, factory performance, and forecasts.

Identify financial trends, explain variances, and recommend actions to the CEO.

Strengthen Tally Prime usage, automated voucher controls, data accuracy, financial integration, and reporting automation.

2. Job Costing, Cost Centres and Budgetary Control

Implement order-wise costing from quotation through manufacturing, dispatch, installation, and warranty.

Capture material, labour, subcontracting, freight, installation, overheads, and other attributable costs.

Compare estimated and actual order margins, identify cost overruns, and support corrective action.

Establish cost centres across factories, departments, and business activities, with appropriate overhead allocation.

Introduce annual budgets, periodic forecasts, and monthly budget-versus-actual reviews.

Drive measurable cost optimisation while protecting quality, delivery commitments, and operational needs.

3. Cash Flow, Working Capital and Banking

Establish a rolling cash-flow forecast, supplier payment schedule, and regular cash reviews.

Monitor overdue receivables, customer credit exposure, and approved payment-after-dispatch arrangements.

Implement inventory ageing, inventory turnover, stock reconciliation, and work-in-progress valuation.

Manage banking relationships, performance bank guarantees, advance bank guarantees, and related limits and charges.

Arrange suitable funding facilities when justified by growth, acquisitions, or working-capital requirements.

4. Internal Controls, SOPs and Compliance

Build practical SOPs and approval controls for purchases, vendor selection, expenses, payroll, payments, and customer credit.

Establish clear delegation of authority, segregation of duties, and supporting-document requirements.

Coordinate inventory verification, internal audits, and closure of control weaknesses.

Own taxation, statutory compliance, audit coordination, and financial risk management, working with external specialists where required.

Maintain a compliance calendar and ensure timely filings, reconciliations, and resolution of outstanding matters.

5. Corporate Transition, Acquisitions and Growth

Lead financial preparation and coordination for the planned transition from proprietorship to a corporate entity.

Work with the CEO, CA, company secretary, and legal advisers on the transition roadmap and implementation.

Strengthen financial records, governance, controls, and reporting to support future fundraising and public-issue readiness.

Evaluate acquisition opportunities through financial due diligence, valuation analysis, funding assessment, and integration planning.

Support pricing, capital expenditure, expansion, and investment decisions with clear financial analysis.

6. Team Leadership and Cross-functional Execution

Develop the existing accounts team through training, defined responsibilities, and performance reviews.

Work closely with purchase, stores, production, sales, service, and HR to ensure reliable financial data and process adherence.

Visit Alwar regularly to review factory controls, stock, costing, and operational performance.

Present financial findings clearly and drive agreed actions to completion.

Authority and Accountability

Within the approved delegation of authority, the CFO will be empowered to:

Enforce financial controls and documentation requirements.

Challenge expenditure and escalate exceptions.

Establish customer credit limits and payment controls.

Participate in pricing, funding, and investment decisions.

Recommend changes to systems, processes, and finance-team structure.

The CFO will be accountable for reporting accuracy, financial visibility, control effectiveness, compliance discipline, and delivery of agreed improvement targets.

Candidate Requirements

Chartered Accountant preferred; CA Intermediate candidates with strong relevant experience will also be considered.

title: Talent Insights Manager - Global Businesses & Functions
description:
**Locations**: Gurgaon | London

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As a Talent Insights Manager, you will help our Global Businesses & Functions (GBF) build a more integrated and forward-looking understanding of our existing workforce and talent and translate that intelligence into better talent and workforce decisions. You will bring together internal data on workforce composition, roles, competencies, hiring, compensation, performance, potential, career progression, and retention with external intelligence on labor-market dynamics, emerging skills, talent scarcity, and market compensation.

Your focus will be on connecting these signals, not simply reporting them, to identify emerging talent and capability risks and translate them into strategic guidance. You will help leaders understand where critical talent sits today, where internal or external trends may create future risks, and where BCG may need to adjust how we attract, recognize, reward, and retain the talent and capabilities most important to our future.

You will also help advance our analytics maturity over time, moving from primarily historical reporting toward stronger leading indicators, scenario analysis, and increasingly forward-looking workforce insights and decision support.

Key activities:

* Support the continued development of BCG’s workforce reporting and analytics, improving the consistency, quality, and usefulness of existing HR metrics while identifying opportunities to simplify and automate recurring analysis.
* Analyze workforce data including headcount, roles, competencies, hiring, performance, potential, promotions, and attrition to identify trends and areas requiring further investigation.
* Compare talent data across employee populations to identify patterns in hiring, performance, progression, retention, and other workforce outcomes.
* Combine compensation data with performance, potential, career progression, talent scarcity, and available market benchmarks to help assess how effectively BCG is recognizing and retaining key talent and identify where compensation actions may warrant consideration.
* Incorporate external labor-market data to provide context on talent availability, emerging skills, hiring demand, compensation, and areas where critical talent may be harder to attract or retain.
* Build on historical reporting by testing new metrics and leading indicators that can provide earlier visibility into emerging workforce trends and risks and develop scenario analyses that help leaders understand the potential implications of different workforce and talent choices.
* Leverage AI and emerging analytical tools to accelerate analysis, identify patterns and anomalies, test hypotheses, and explore new ways to make workforce insights more scalable and actionable.
* Prepare analyses, dashboards, decision-support tools, and leadership materials that clearly explain findings, supporting data, and areas that may warrant action or further analysis.
* Maintain accuracy and consistency across complex datasets while connecting detailed findings to broader business questions and applying appropriate judgment to the interpretation and use of data and AI-generated insights.

What You'll Bring

* 6–8 years of experience in analytics, HR, workforce planning, talent, consulting, or related roles, with experience using data to inform business decisions.
* Bachelor’s degree with experience working with complex workforce, talent, or business data.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to connect detailed data and metrics to broader workforce and business questions and develop and test hypotheses.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office and Power BI, plus demonstrated ability to use GenAI and other analytical tools to support analysis and problem solving.
* Experience combining and interpreting data from multiple sources to identify trends, relationships, and anomalies, and areas requiring further investigation.
* Experience translating complex analyses into clear, structured materials and insights for senior leadership, including implications and potential areas for action.
* Strong attention to detail and organization, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and data integrity.

The following experience would be beneficial but is not required:

* Experience with workforce planning, compensation, talent analytics, or external labor-market intelligence.
* Experience with scenario analysis, forecasting, or other forward-looking analytical approaches.
* Experience using AI, automation, or other technology to simplify or scale recurring analytical work.

Who You'll Work With

You will be part of our Global Businesses & Function HR team, sitting within the Talent Insights & Compensation team. This team brings together workforce, talent, compensation, and external market information to help our businesses and functions better understand their talent and inform people decisions.

You will work across BCG’s global corporate functions and businesses, partnering with HR and business leaders and teams to understand their workforce questions and translate available data into meaningful insights. You will also collaborate with colleagues across talent, compensation, recruiting, and other HR teams to connect different perspectives and provide a more complete view of our workforce and talent.

Additional info

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
